entries.name: BTC Price Check
entries.summary: Manual Tor-routed BTC price fetch. Extracts USD from the JSON response and shows it in the notification.

entries.name: Daily OPSEC Status
entries.summary: Manual status snapshot for Tor, BLE, battery and local mode.

entries.name: Daily OPSEC Briefing Draft
entries.summary: Safe draft for a future scheduled briefing. It snapshots local built-in variables only.

entries.name: Dead Man Check Draft
entries.summary: Safe draft: creates the DMS pending variable and notification. Timed execution is intentionally not armed yet.

entries.name: Field Kit: Low Battery Reminder
entries.summary: At the 20% battery crossing, remind the operator to defer optional heavy analysis. Does not stop calls, transfers, radios or other active tools.

entries.name: Field Kit: Review When Charging
entries.summary: When charging starts and a review was queued, show a generic reminder and clear the pending flag. Does not run OCR or a tool automatically. Enable Android notifications for reminders.

entries.name: Field Kit: Daily Review Reminder
entries.summary: Optional daily reminder at 09:00 device time. Android may defer scheduled work. Never launches a tool, scans files or sends data automatically.

entries.name: Field Kit: Check Local Data
entries.summary: Check input.json, then input.db using the reviewed JSON Structure Summary and SQLite Read-Only Check tools. Stops if an action fails; the final result is the database report.

entries.name: Field Kit: Fingerprint a File
entries.summary: Read a local file fingerprint. Requires the reviewed File Fingerprint tool and input.bin in /workspace/fieldkit.

entries.name: Field Kit: Local Web Lab
entries.summary: Manual reviewed loopback test. Install and enable Loopback Web Lab, prepare words.txt and your own server at 127.0.0.1:8080. Explicit Security Lab Open network policy is required.

entries.name: Field Kit: OCR with Battery Check
entries.summary: Run reviewed Offline English OCR only when battery is at least 20%. Prepare input.png. A manual battery condition example; no background OCR.

entries.name: Field Kit: Review a PDF
entries.summary: Inspect one PDF before sharing. Requires the reviewed PDF Structure Check tool and input.pdf. Does not send or rewrite the file.

entries.name: Field Kit: Queue a Review Reminder
entries.summary: Set one local pending flag for the charging reminder example. No file paths or report contents are stored.

entries.name: Field Kit: Review a Shell Script
entries.summary: Run the reviewed Shell Script Review tool on input.sh without executing the script. Findings remain in the local result.

entries.name: Field Kit: Verify Received Evidence
entries.summary: Verify input.bin with signer.pub and input.minisig using the reviewed signature tool. Trust the public key independently. No automatic download or sharing.

entries.name: Field Kit: Offline Work Reminder
entries.summary: On Wi-Fi disconnection, show a generic reminder about local tools. Does not change routing or start a connection.

entries.name: Mesh Readiness Card
entries.summary: Local readiness card for BLE, LoRa and Ghost mode without sending network traffic.

entries.name: Mode Change Logger
entries.summary: Example QVar trigger that logs every change to %Q_MODE.

entries.name: Office Mode
entries.summary: Manual scenario for a quieter profile with conservative automation.

entries.name: Offline Mode
entries.summary: Manual scenario that records an offline-first operating mode.

entries.name: Onion Identity Card
entries.summary: Builds a local chat card with current onion identity, Tor state and dynamic port variables.

entries.name: Pro Threat Scanner
entries.summary: Example Pro pipeline using IF blocks, math QVars and hashing without Python.

entries.name: Python SDK Demo
entries.summary: Community developer example: import qp1ng, read/write QVars and emit scenario output.

entries.name: Q-Brain OPSEC Brief
entries.summary: Asks the local model for a short operational checklist using live Q-P1NG variables.

entries.name: Regex Redactor Demo
entries.summary: Example Pro string tool: redacts token-like fields from a QVar without Python.

entries.name: Security Snapshot
entries.summary: Manual local snapshot that writes OPSEC state to encrypted notes.

entries.name: Split / Join QVar Demo
entries.summary: Example Pro array workflow using indexed QVars and a joined output.

entries.name: Tor Auto Status
entries.summary: Example automatic trigger fired when the Tor circuit becomes ready.

entries.name: Tor Circuit Probe
entries.summary: Manual Tor health probe using the app dynamic SOCKS port, then extracts the reported exit IP.

entries.name: Travel Mode
entries.summary: Manual scenario that arms travel variables and reminds the user that quick OPSEC mode is active.

entries.name: Loopback Web Lab
entries.summary: Test up to 20 simple path names on your own local server at 127.0.0.1:8080. One worker, two requests/second, 20-second limit. Requires explicit reviewed Open network policy in Security Lab; this tool never changes settings or starts a server. Install: ffuf.

entries.name: File Fingerprint
entries.summary: Identify one file and calculate SHA-256 and BLAKE3 without modifying it. Maximum 32 MiB; hashes show byte equality, not authenticity. Install: file, b3sum.

entries.name: JSON Structure Summary
entries.summary: Validate exactly one JSON document and summarize its top-level type, size and up to 40 keys. Values are not printed. Maximum 2 MiB. Empty input and multiple JSON documents are rejected. Install: jq.

entries.name: File Metadata Report
entries.summary: Read embedded metadata as JSON, including any location tags. Maximum 32 MiB. This inspects metadata; it does not remove it or publish the result. Install: exiftool.

entries.name: Offline English OCR
entries.summary: Recognize English text in a PNG and display it locally. Maximum 8 MiB, 60 seconds, one OCR thread. Use a reasonably sized page image; compressed size does not bound decoded pixels. Review names and numbers against the original. Install: tesseract-ocr, tesseract-ocr-data-eng.

entries.name: PDF Structure Check
entries.summary: Check PDF syntax and count pages without rewriting the source. Maximum 32 MiB. A valid structure is not a malware or redaction guarantee. Password-protected input may require a separate reviewed workflow. Install: qpdf.

entries.name: Shell Script Review
entries.summary: Inspect a POSIX shell script with ShellCheck and show formatting differences with shfmt. The script is never executed or rewritten. Maximum 128 KiB. Findings are review items, not a proof that a script is safe. Install: shellcheck, shfmt.

entries.name: Verify a Minisign Signature
entries.summary: Verify input.bin against a detached signature and a trusted public key. Maximum 32 MiB. Obtain the public key through an independently trusted channel. Does not create keys, sign files or access the network. Install: minisign.

entries.name: SQLite Read-Only Check
entries.summary: Run a read-only SQLite quick check and list up to 40 table/view names. Does not print row contents. Maximum 32 MiB. Use a consistent exported database, not a copied live database without its WAL. Install: sqlite.

entries.name: Compare Two Text Files
entries.summary: Show a unified text diff between two workspace files. Each file may be up to 1 MiB. No originals are rewritten; output can contain sensitive text and should be reviewed before sharing. Install: diffutils.

entries.name: Incident Timeline Summary
entries.summary: Summarize a JSON array of up to 2,000 events with timestamp, source and text fields. Timestamps must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ in UTC. Prints count, time range and source counts, not event text. Maximum 2 MiB. Install: jq.

entries.name: Local YARA Rule Match
entries.summary: Apply your reviewed YARA rules to one local file. Rules up to 64 KiB, input up to 8 MiB, scan timeout 10 seconds. No process scanning, downloading or execution. A match is an indicator to investigate, not proof of malware. Install: yara.

entries.name: ZIP Inventory Without Extraction
entries.summary: List the ZIP central directory without extracting or executing its entries. Maximum 32 MiB. This is an inventory, not a malware check or a full integrity test. Install: unzip.

entries.name: Zstandard Integrity Check
entries.summary: Test a Zstandard stream without writing decompressed output. Compressed input is limited to 32 MiB, decoder window to 64 MiB and runtime to 30 seconds. This checks format integrity, not authenticity. Install: zstd.

entries.name: Base64 Toolkit
entries.summary: Offline Base64 encoder/decoder with standard and URL-safe variants.

entries.name: Clipboard Security Scanner
entries.summary: Scans Q-P1NG secure clipboard text for keys, seeds, cards and onion addresses.

entries.name: Incident Runbook Builder
entries.summary: Converts selected incident notes into a concise action checklist.

entries.name: Incident Timeline Builder
entries.summary: Pulls timestamped lines from logs or chats into a compact incident timeline.

entries.name: IOC Extractor
entries.summary: Extracts hashes, IPs, domains, onions and URLs from selected incident text.

entries.name: JSON Pretty Validator
entries.summary: Formats JSON and reports parser errors without network.

entries.name: JWT Inspector
entries.summary: Decodes JWT header/payload offline without verifying signature.

entries.name: Lab Nmap Quick Recon
entries.summary: Reviewed nmap template for one authorized target: host discovery plus top ports.

entries.name: Lab Nmap Top Ports
entries.summary: Reviewed nmap service/version template for a small authorized port set.

entries.name: Lab Tcpdump Host Snapshot
entries.summary: Reviewed tcpdump template: capture 20 packets for one authorized host filter.

entries.name: Onion Address Inspector
entries.summary: Validates selected v3 onion text and prints safe Tor workflow reminders.

entries.name: Passphrase Generator
entries.summary: Generates a local high-entropy passphrase and compact backup code.

entries.name: Password Strength Estimator
entries.summary: Offline entropy and crack-time estimate for selected text.

entries.name: Python Code Runner
entries.summary: Runs selected Python in Linux Sandbox after Review -> Edit -> Run.

entries.name: Secret Redactor
entries.summary: Redacts API keys, private key blocks, cards, emails and phone-like tokens.

entries.name: SHA-256 Text Hash
entries.summary: Offline hash of selected text. No sandbox and no network.

entries.name: Smart Text Detector
entries.summary: Classifies selected text as hash, URL, onion, BTC address, seed phrase or code.

entries.name: URL Defanger
entries.summary: Turns selected links into safe shareable text for reports.

entries.name: YARA Skeleton Builder
entries.summary: Turns selected suspicious strings into a reviewable defensive YARA rule draft.
